title: Nvidia reports Q3 revenue up 103% YoY to $115.8B, above $109.1B est., Data Center revenue up 110% to $107.6B, and forecasts Q4 revenue above estimates (Nvidia Newsroom)
summary: Nvidia Newsroom: Nvidia reports Q3 revenue up 103% YoY to $115.8B, above $109.1B est., Data Center revenue up 110% to $107.6B, and forecasts Q4 revenue above estimates — - Revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago — Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion, up 110% from a year ago
